name: Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / VC Dimension
details: A shattered set projects to a full cube, whose positive no-clashing teaching dimension equals its dimension.
witness_verification: For every n >= 4, Singleton-Cosingleton has VC 3 (value 1127) and positive projected RTD n-1 (value 1129). Survey Proposition prop:positive-projection-collapse identifies positive projected no-clashing teaching with positive projected RTD. Thus the endpoint ratio is (n-1)/3 and is unbounded. The former finite witness {001,010,111}, with values 2 versus 1, remains valid and its class/value records are retained. No unbounded separation between the equal positive projection closures is claimed.
proof: Let S be shattered with |S|=d. Then $\mathcal H_{|S}$ is the full d-cube and has $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}=d$. Thus $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+p}(\mathcal H)\ge d$; maximize over shattered S.
